description: Anomaly detection for one numeric time series (8..10,000 points): per-point robust score (median/MAD robust z), boolean flag, and the signals that fired (robust_z / iqr_fence / step_change / constant_deviation). Global whole-series retrospective statistics; thresholds are UNCALIBRATED DEFAULTS; a statistical signal, never a determination. Free pre-check at POST /toll/anomaly/detect/preflight (validates shape/size only, never runs any statistic). $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/anomaly/detect.

sensitivity.description: string - threshold preset: relaxed flags fewer, standard is the default, strict flags more

series.description: array (required) - the numeric series to score, in order (8..10,000 finite numbers)

timestamps.description: array - optional opaque labels, exactly series.length elements, echoed verbatim per point; never parsed or used in computation

name: anomaly_detect
